name: D07_5_enters_trigger_checks_its_if_again_as_it_resolves
notes: Printed: 'When this enchantment enters, if you control a creature with power 4 or greater, draw a card.' (an intervening if, CR 603.4: true as the trigger fires AND as it resolves). The Uprising enters with my 4/4 in play, so its trigger goes on the stack; in response my 4/4 leaves the battlefield. As the trigger resolves I control no creature with power 4 or greater: nothing is drawn (the hand stays empty, the library full).
